Decode.TranslatedText: Time to First Treatment-Emergent Skin and Subcutaneous Tissue Disorder (days)

Description.TranslatedText: AGEGR1 = '<65' when AGE < 65, '>=65' when AGE >= 65. AGEGR1N = 1, 2 respectively.
'Y' when the subject was randomised (RANDDT is not missing), else 'N'. FASFL is set equal to ITTFL.
'Y' when the subject received at least one dose of study drug (TRTSDT is not missing), else 'N'.
BMIBL = WEIGHTBL / (HEIGHTBL / 100)^2, in kg/m2. HEIGHTBL and WEIGHTBL are the baseline height (cm) and weight (kg) from VS.
ADT - TRTSDT + 1 when ADT >= TRTSDT, else ADT - TRTSDT.
'Y' when ASTDT >= TRTSDT and ASTDT <= TRTEDT + 30 days, or when the event worsened after the first dose; otherwise 'N'.
'Y' for the last non-missing AVAL on or before TRTSDT, within each USUBJID and PARAMCD.
AVAL of the record with ABLFL = 'Y' within each USUBJID and PARAMCD.
AVAL - BASE for post-baseline records; missing for the baseline record.
100 * CHG / BASE when BASE is not 0.
'LOW' when AVAL < ANRLO, 'HIGH' when AVAL > ANRHI, else 'NORMAL'. BNRIND is ANRIND of the baseline record.

MethodDef.Name: Algorithm to derive AVAL (time to event)

Description.TranslatedText: (ADT - STARTDT + 1) / 30.4375 for PFS, OS and DOR (months); ADT - STARTDT + 1 for TTSKIN (days).
0 when the event occurred, 1 when the subject was censored; see CNSDTDSC for the censoring date used.
Two subjects were randomised but not dosed (ARMNRS = 'ASSIGNED, NOT TREATED'); they are in the FAS and not in the SAF.
PFS events and censoring follow the PFS censoring rules of the SAP.
The Full Analysis Set is the same as the Intent-to-Treat population.
